title: AIKA AI
desc: A local AI desktop companion powered entirely by on-device language models.
overview: AIKA is a living desktop AI companion currently in active development. Running entirely on local Ollama models, it combines conversational AI, long-term memory, multi-agent collaboration, planning, research, and operating system integration into a privacy-focused assistant that grows alongside its user.
approach: Built a modular multi-agent architecture supporting specialized agents for planning, research, writing, and task execution with automatic model routing, streaming responses, and native tool calling.

Implemented long-term semantic memory using PostgreSQL and pgvector, together with local tools including file management, shell execution, web research, Git integration, planning, configuration management, and OS automation.
outcome: Currently under active development with 100+ automated tests covering memory, orchestration, streaming, tool use, safety systems, and multi-agent workflows. The project demonstrates advanced local AI engineering focused on privacy, extensibility, and intelligent desktop automation.

title: InvenTrack
stack: React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Python, Flask
desc: A web-based inventory management and decision support system for local government offices.
overview: InvenTrack is a web-based inventory management and decision support system developed for the General Services Office (GSO) of the Municipality of Padre Garcia. The platform improves inventory monitoring, supply management, and procurement planning through descriptive and predictive analytics.
approach: Built a full-stack inventory management platform with real-time stock monitoring, procurement workflows, audit trails, reporting, and role-based access control.
Integrated predictive and descriptive analytics to forecast inventory demand, identify usage trends, and support data-driven decision making for government operations.
outcome: Delivered a capstone-ready government information system that modernizes inventory management while applying analytics to improve operational planning.

title: EverestIQ
desc: A machine learning platform for Himalayan expedition risk.
overview: Built on historical Himalayan Database records, EverestIQ predicts three things at once: how difficult a peak actually is, how long summiting is likely to take, and the fatality risk of an expedition given its conditions.
approach: Four separate models handle the four prediction tasks — peak difficulty, summit time, fatality risk, and overall expedition success — each trained independently on cleaned expedition and member datasets.
A Flask dashboard exposes the models through simple prediction forms, with feature-importance and confusion-matrix visualizations surfaced alongside the results rather than buried in a notebook.
outcome: Delivered a multi-model ML pipeline trained on thousands of historical Himalayan expeditions, demonstrating how structured data and ensemble methods can turn raw records into actionable risk intelligence.

title: EmpowerPWD
desc: An inclusive employment platform connecting Persons with Disabilities to accessible job opportunities.
overview: EmpowerPWD is an inclusive employment platform designed to reduce employment barriers faced by Persons with Disabilities (PWDs). The system connects job seekers with employers committed to accessible and inclusive hiring while providing an intuitive application experience.
approach: Developed separate portals for employers and PWD applicants, enabling job posting, profile management, application tracking, and recruitment workflows.
Designed accessibility-first interfaces with responsive layouts and straightforward navigation to accommodate diverse users and encourage inclusive hiring.
outcome: Demonstrated how technology can promote equal employment opportunities while showcasing full-stack application development with accessibility considerations.

title: Spartan Odyssey
desc: A gamified educational game that teaches SQL through narrative-driven challenges.
overview: Spartan Odyssey is a narrative-driven educational game that helps IT students strengthen SQL programming skills through progressive challenges, interactive storytelling, and gamified learning mechanics.
approach: Designed progressively challenging SQL puzzles integrated into story-driven gameplay to reinforce database concepts through practice rather than memorization.
Implemented gamification features including level progression, achievements, feedback systems, and adaptive learning challenges to improve engagement.
outcome: Showcased how game design principles can enhance programming education while demonstrating gameplay system development and educational software design.

title: SoundSprint
desc: A sound-based quiz game built in Flutter.
overview: A quiz game where the questions are sounds, not text — built to explore Flutter's audio and animation handling outside of a typical CRUD app.
approach: Designed a round-based quiz system with timed rounds, scoring based on response speed and accuracy, and a curated library of sound clips spanning music, nature, and ambient categories.
Built with Flutter's declarative widget tree and animation controllers to deliver smooth cross-platform performance with responsive touch controls and real-time feedback.
outcome: Picked up a small amount of organic traction on GitHub (3 stars) without any promotion.

title: Aika Stream
stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TMDB API
desc: A personal movie and series discovery platform with a cinematic browsing experience.
overview: Aika Stream is a personal movie and TV series discovery space built for watching, saving, and exploring favorite stories through a clean, cinematic interface. Rather than replicating a streaming service, it focuses on helping users discover content, organize watchlists, and enjoy a visually immersive browsing experience.
approach: Integrated TMDB APIs to provide searchable movies, TV shows, trending content, detailed information pages, and personalized watchlists.
Designed a responsive cinematic interface inspired by modern streaming platforms, emphasizing large visuals, smooth transitions, and effortless navigation.
outcome: Created a polished entertainment discovery platform that demonstrates API integration, responsive UI design, and modern frontend development practices.
